title: Core/PR Job Runner: Unexpected Race Condition in Linux/Editor with ThreadSanitizer Job on PR
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible on 4.6dev [1f7630f1bf]

### System information

N/A

### Issue description

Yesterday i force pushed to one of my PRs (#110950), and as the jobs were running, the Linux Editor job with ThreadSanitizer exited with error code 66, due to a race condition in [core/object/message_queue.cpp](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/core/object/message_queue.cpp). 
This issue appeared to be a random bug, as the PR in question does not modify anything in Core, so I asked @Ivorforce and he restarted it. After the restart, the job completed with no issues. 

I also noticed that the number of race conditions found within different files by this job varies slightly each time, indicating non-deterministic behavior. Deadlocks seem constant in amount however.

Job logs: 
* Failed job log (14 race cons): [github job link](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/actions/runs/18076832219/job/51434600659?pr=110950) ; [pastebin log](https://pastebin.com/XmDCDQ3i)
* Restarted successful job log (22 race cons): [github job link](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/actions/runs/18076832219/job/51505853495?pr=110950) ; [pastebin log](https://pastebin.com/AhAScrme)

### Steps to reproduce

Appears to be random, N/A
